newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades Digital.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon upgrades Digital.

text.p: - Salomon Brothers analyst John Jones said he raised his recommendation on Digital Equipment Corp to a "strong buy" from a "buy".
- Shares were trading up 2-1/2 at 39-1/4 in late morning exchange trade
- "The business momentum at DEC, both in their PC and their servers, is picking up. Their NT business is extremely healthy," Jones told Reuters.
- Jones said he maintains earnings estimates of $1.64 per share for fiscal 1997 versus a street consensus of $0.99 and $3.80 per share for fiscal 1998 versus a street consensus of $2.80.
- Jones said Digital's StrongARM micropressor has been winning a "significant" number of contracts and will help turn around the semiconductor division.
